channel.title: Exec Updates
channel.description: Stable updates for Exec on macOS.

item.description:
## Changes
- Updated the app icon with a solid dark background. - Deferred Keychain access on fresh installs until a provider is selected. - Fixed update-badge restoration and click flicker. - Added compaction activity to the transcript and reset stale context usage after compaction. - Kept tool rows stable as activity indicators change. - Added a stopping state while cancellation completes and removed stopped labels from replies. - Reduced account-allowance refreshes to after runs.
## Install
[Download the DMG installer](https://github.com/maxibenner/exec/releases/download/v0.1.2/Exec-macOS-arm64.dmg), open it, and drag **Exec** into **Applications**.
Requires **macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon**. Existing installations can update through **Settings → Updates → Check for Updates…**. The ZIP is for Sparkle in-app updates; use the DMG for manual installation. SHA-256 checksums are included for both downloads.

## Changes
- Added ⌘S to toggle the sidebar. - Improved chat resizing performance. - Tool cards now appear as execution starts. - Chats continue after recoverable tool failures. - User messages now have blue backgrounds. - Manually chosen session names are preserved.
## Install
[Download the DMG installer](https://github.com/maxibenner/exec/releases/download/v0.1.1/Exec-macOS-arm64.dmg), open it, and drag **Exec** into **Applications**.
Requires **macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon**. Existing installations can update through **Settings → Updates → Check for Updates…**. The ZIP is for Sparkle in-app updates; use the DMG for manual installation. SHA-256 checksums are included for both downloads.
